Set up the Python environment for the NumPyro / JAX engine

Source: R/python_env.R
setup_numpyro_env.Rd

Creates (or updates) a Python environment with jax and numpyro for hb_area(engine = "jax") and activates it for reticulate.

Usage

setup_numpyro_env(envname = "r-numpyro-gpu", method = "auto", device = "auto")

Arguments

envname

Name of the conda or virtualenv environment. Default "r-numpyro-gpu".

method

"auto" (virtualenv), "virtualenv", or "conda".

device

"auto" (CUDA if nvidia-smi is found, otherwise CPU), "metal" (Apple Silicon), "cuda" (NVIDIA), or "cpu". Versions are pinned to tested combinations: jax==0.5.0 and numpyro==0.19.0 for CPU/CUDA; jax==0.4.34, jaxlib==0.4.34, jax-metal==0.1.1 for Metal.

Value

Invisible logical TRUE upon successful setup.

See also

check_numpyro_available, hb_area

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
setup_numpyro_env(device = "auto")
} # }
